hero.eyebrow: A social network for African cultures
hero.title: Share your culture. Learn from every other.
hero.lede: Post in your own language. Read anyone's story in yours.
how.title: From your voice to the world, on your terms
how.s1: Write, record or photograph something from your culture, in your language.
how.s2: Add where, when and how you know it. Sources make a story trustworthy.
how.s3: Choose who sees it. Readers get it in their language; your original stays.
cultures.title: Every country holds many cultures
cultures.lede: Each card is a door. Open one and tell what you know.
live.empty: No public story yet. Be the first to share one.
langs.title: Write in yours. Read in any.
langs.lede: Languages marked with a dot have interface text translated by machine. Speakers can help correct it.
collections.title: Objects of Kasai
collections.lede: Museum reference records, kept separate from community stories.
rights.title: Your rights
rights.c1: Nothing is public until you approve it.
rights.c2: Withdraw a story at any time. Copies already downloaded cannot be recalled.
rights.c3: Your words are kept as you wrote them. Translations are labelled.
footer.tagline: Stories stay under the storyteller's control.
machine.notice: This language was translated automatically and has not yet been checked by a speaker.
machineTranslationLabel: Machine translation, not checked by a speaker
audience.publicDescription: Anyone can read it, even without an account
audience.membersDescription: Only people signed in to Story Bridge
audience.privateDescription: Private, nobody else can see it
audience.heading: Who can see this story?
audience.pending: Who can see this: Only me (until a moderator approves it as {choice})
audience.aiUnavailable: AI drafts are temporarily unavailable. Write the translation yourself; readers can still use Read in my language.
